title: Mistral AI Releases Forge
cleaned_content: Mistral AI has released "Forge," a new development platform designed to streamline the creation and deployment of applications utilizing Mistral's models. This platform aims to provide developers with enhanced tooling, standardized APIs, and MLOps support, accelerating the integration of Mistral models into production systems. Forge represents a significant step in building out Mistral's ecosystem, making its models more accessible and easier to work with for enterprise use cases.
